# Arceo Studio Collective

> Arceo Studio Collective runs on-site member portrait programs for private clubs in the United States. Members sit for a portrait at their own clubhouse, against a consistent hand-painted backdrop. The club receives a directory portrait of each member for its membership roster, point-of-sale system, and staff training directory, so staff can greet members by name. Members pay no sitting fee. Owner and head photographer: Julian Arceo.

## Key facts

- Who it serves: private clubs, meaning country, golf, city, yacht, and athletic clubs, and their general managers, membership directors, and member services teams.
- What the club receives: one consistent directory portrait per member, with a complimentary "club-edit" retouch that keeps members recognizable to staff.
- What members receive: no sitting fee, a complimentary 5x7, a directed sitting, and a review of their portraits in the same session.
- Session styles: Business and Branding (efficient, professional headshot), and Family and Legacy (longer and guided, with families welcome).
- Session length: 20 to 120 minutes, depending on session style and party size.
- Optional purchases: print and digital packages from $150, with no minimums.
